items.summary: Identify and fix the root cause of the customer order placement flow getting stuck in a perpetual loading state when submitting the order form ("Create Order" / "Place Order"). Ensure the mutation always resolves (success or error) and the UI never remains stuck on loading indefinitely.

Backend: Add a caller-safe ban-status API that the frontend can use without causing unresolved calls. Implement a `public query ({ caller }) func isCallerBanned() : async Bool` that returns whether `caller` is in the banned set, and enforce that only authenticated users can call it (same permission gate style used elsewhere).

Frontend: Make the create-order mutation robust against hanging canister calls by wrapping the backend order-creation call in a timeout (Promise.race) and surfacing the timeout as a user-facing error, so the submit button cannot remain stuck in `createOrder.isPending`.

Frontend: Improve error reporting for failed order creation so users aren’t left with only a spinner. Ensure errors from backend traps/rejects are converted into clear English messages and displayed in the existing error Alert on NewOrderPage.
